question: For each risk tolerance, what is the average number of holdings per investor, the average number of rebalancing actions per investor (investors with none count as 0), and the average risk score?
sql_query: WITH a AS (SELECT investor_id, COUNT(*) AS v FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 GROUP BY investor_id), b AS (SELECT investor_id, COUNT(*) AS v FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance, ROUND(AVG(a.v),2) AS avg_holdings, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(b.v,0)),2) AS avg_rebalances, ROUND(AVG(h.risk_score),2) AS avg_risk_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id LEFT JOIN a ON a.investor_id=p.investor_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average total sector investment and average allocation percentage of investors.
sql_query:
WITH alloc AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) a_inv, AVG(allocation_pct) a_pct FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(al.a_inv),2) AS avg_sector_investment,
       ROUND(AVG(al.a_pct),2) AS avg_allocation_pct,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN alloc al ON al.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

question: Across time horizon, compare the average net cash flow, average signed cash-flow amount, and average cash-flow count of investors.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net, AVG(amount) c_avg, COUNT(*) c_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.time_horizon AS time_horizon,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_net),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_avg),2) AS avg_cashflow_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_cnt),2) AS avg_cashflow_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.time_horizon
ORDER BY p.time_horizon;

question: Across time horizon, compare the average scenario shift (new minus current allocation %) and average scenario count (0 for investors with no scenario records) of investors.

WITH scen AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift, COUNT(*) s_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.time_horizon AS time_horizon,
       ROUND(AVG(sc.s_shift),2) AS avg_scenario_shift,

       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.time_horizon
ORDER BY p.time_horizon;

question: List the top 10 investors ranked by a composite score (0-100 index) combining net cash flow, total holding gain (counting only holdings with a recorded cost and current value), total scenario allocation shift (sum of new minus current allocation %) and risk score. Over investors that have all 4 components, min-max normalise each component to 0-1, and take 100 times their equal-weighted mean; break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     hold AS (SELECT o.investor_id, SUM(o.current_value-o.cost) h_gain FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o WHERE o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.investor_id),
     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 ho.h_gain AS holding_gain,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift,
                 h.risk_score AS risk_score
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN hold ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND ho.h_gain IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL AND h.risk_score IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(holding_gain) mn_1, MAX(holding_gain) mx_1, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_2, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_2, MIN(risk_score) mn_3, MAX(risk_score) mx_3 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (holding_gain-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0) + (risk_score-b.mn_3)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_3-b.mn_3,0))/4.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.holding_gain,2) AS holding_gain,
       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift,
       ROUND(per.risk_score,2) AS risk_score
FROM per, b
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, per.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
